parsed.rationale: Both `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage` and `HLSRateDidChangeMessage` are `type-alias-object` kinds with identical structure (`shared_field_count: 2`, `differing_slots: null`) living in the same `Playback` package but in sibling sub-modules (`RadioPlayer/Messages/` and `HLSPlayer/Messages/`). Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app` are all false). The names differ only in the player-technology prefix, indicating the distinction is incidental to the underlying concept — a rate-change message — rather than semantically meaningful. A single canonical `RateDidChangeMessage` type-alias placed in a shared messages file within the `Playback` package (e.g., `Shared/Playback/Sources/Messages/PlaybackMessages.swift`) would eliminate the duplication while both `RadioPlayer` and `HLSPlayer` modules retain their own type-aliases pointing to it if local naming is still desired.
